case.summary: The investigation found four online purchases on card C00466-K1, each just under a $500 authorization limit, totaling $1,860.43 within 24 minutes. Evidence shows this pattern matches a known coordinated scheme that has appeared on 11 other cards, and the card had a prior fraud link. The case was escalated to a fraud analyst, who confirmed the coordinated nature of the activity. The card was blocked, pending authorizations were declined, connected cards were monitored, a report was filed, and the case remains open for further review.

Authorization-threshold structuring: 4 online purchases on one card, each between $400 and $500, inside about 24 minutes, from more than one device. The amounts look chosen to stay just under a $500 authorization limit. The same run shape appears on 11 other cards in the surrounding weeks, so it is a repeated scheme across customers rather than one compromised card.
